terms.meaning: makes a value available for other files to import and use

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: File purpose comment
sections.what: A comment at the top stating that the content here comes from the existing portfolio. It does not change how the site works.
sections.why: Tells a future reader where the wording came from.

sections.name: site
sections.title: Owner's name, contact and links
sections.what: Holds the owner's full name, first and last name, tagline, short descriptor, current focus, location, education, and links to LinkedIn and GitHub.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely the source for the header and contact area on every page.
sections.watch_out: The link addresses are used as they are, so a mistyped address sends visitors to the wrong place.

sections.name: intro
sections.title: Plain and technical introduction text
sections.what: Holds the introduction in two versions, a plain one and a technical one, each as a list of paragraphs. The two versions share the first paragraph.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets visitors pick a level of detail. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The two versions are edited separately, so a change to the story in one may not reach the other.

summary: Holds the site-wide personal details, contact links, and the two versions of the introduction text, all written as plain data.
purpose: Stores the owner's name, tagline, location, education, links and the introduction so every page can show the same content.
why: Likely reason: keeping shared wording in one file means it only needs to be changed once. Reason not stated in the code.
how: The file first has a comment, then the site object with the personal details and links, then the intro object with two lists of paragraphs, one plain and one technical.
inputs: Nothing is read from outside. The text is typed into this file.
outputs: Two exported objects, site and intro, used by the pages to show the owner's details and introduction.
risks: A changed link or name appears on every page at once. Links are not checked to see whether they still work.
debug: If a detail shows wrong on the site, look for it in the site object. If the introduction is wrong, check whether the plain or technical list is the one showing.
